intro.h2: We fix what is behind the wall, then make it look new
paragraphs: M&J Demolition & Remodeling LLC does remodeling in Pasadena, TX, and the work often starts where other jobs stop: behind the drywall. One homeowner's 60-year-old dining room had been damaged by termites. Enrique removed and replaced the damaged sheetrock, studs and insulation, then painted the room.

That is the pattern in our reviews. Demolition is in our name, and the same team does the tear-out and the rebuild, whether that is a damaged wall, a bathroom addition or an open commercial space with new floors. Customers describe the team as professional, conscientious and pleasant to work with, and say they would hire us again.

items.name: Damage repair: termites, drywall and studs
items.blurb: When termites or moisture get into a wall, paint alone will not fix it. We open the wall, remove the damaged sheetrock, studs and insulation, replace them and finish with fresh paint and trim, so the room is solid again and looks clean.

items.name: Demolition and tear-out
items.blurb: Demolition is part of our name. On the termite job we stripped the dining room walls back to the studs, kept the dust behind plastic sheeting and cleared the way for the rebuild. We take on residential and commercial demolition.

items.blurb: One customer had Enrique and his team build a bathroom addition and said their skills, professionalism and communication were off the charts. We take on bathroom additions and residential remodeling of rooms and closets in and around Pasadena.

about.h2: About Enrique and the M&J team
about.text: M&J Demolition & Remodeling LLC is a remodeling and demolition company in Pasadena, TX. In our Google reviews, customers name Enrique as the person leading the work, along with his team. The jobs they describe need both skills: opening up a 60-year-old dining room damaged by termites and rebuilding it, and building a bathroom addition. Every review on Google is five stars, and customers use words like professional, conscientious and pleasant to work with. We work for homeowners and for businesses.

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (832) 691-1171 and tell us what is going on: damage you found, a room you want changed, or a space to remodel.

steps.title: Look at the problem
steps.text: We look at the room with you and, if there is damage, find out how far it goes before we quote the work.

steps.title: Demolition
steps.text: We protect the rest of your home or business, then remove damaged or dated materials down to what is solid.

steps.title: Rebuild and finish
steps.text: New studs, insulation, drywall, flooring or fixtures go in, followed by paint and trim so the room is ready to use.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk through the finished space with you and go over what was replaced, so you know what was done behind your walls.

service_area.h2: Remodeling in Pasadena, TX and nearby
service_area.text: M&J Demolition & Remodeling LLC is based in Pasadena, TX, and works at your home or business rather than from a showroom; the Google profile lists no street address. We take on homes and commercial spaces. If you are in Pasadena or close by and not sure we cover your street, call (832) 691-1171 and ask. A few photos of the room help us give you a quick answer.

items.q: Do you repair termite and water damage?
items.a: Yes. In one reviewed job we restored a 60-year-old dining room damaged by termites: we removed and replaced the damaged sheetrock, studs and insulation, then painted. If you have found soft wood, stains or damage behind a wall, call and tell us what you are seeing.

items.q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
items.a: Yes. We describe ourselves as remodeling in general, residential and commercial, plus demolition. Our photos include an open commercial room finished with new flooring and paint. Call with the size of the space, what it is used for and what you need done.

items.q: Can you build a bathroom addition?
items.a: Yes. A customer had Enrique and his team build a bathroom addition and reviewed it with five stars, mentioning skills, professionalism and communication. Every addition is different, so we start by looking at your home and talking through the layout you want.

Our Google profile lists us as open 24 hours, seven days a week. The easiest way to reach us is to call (832) 691-1171 or email en071591@gmail.com with a short description and a few photos of the room or damage.

We are based in Pasadena, TX and travel to our customers; our Google profile lists no street address to visit. If you are in or near Pasadena, call and tell us your address and the job, and we will let you know if we can take it on.

final_cta.text: Call M&J and talk to the team that will do the tear-out and the rebuild.
